name: Amberstinger
rules: Creatures stunned by this creature take 1 less damage from each source while that Stun lasts.

name: Abysscoil
rules: This creature cannot attack. At your turn start, deal 1 damage to an enemy front creature. If it was already damaged, stun it.

name: Moonface Owl
rules: At your turn start, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on top and the other on the bottom.

name: Hatchling of the Hoard
rules: When you play this creature, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Equipment from them and put it in your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.

name: Gym Mouse
rules: After this creature survives combat damage, it gets +1 Attack for the rest of the game. This can trigger once each turn.

name: Ashwing
rules: The first time this creature dies, return it to your hand after combat. Its death still counts as a loss. When replayed, it enters with 3 HP instead of 5.

name: Amethyst Colossus
rules: This creature can only be played in a front slot. When it dies, deal 1 damage to each enemy creature. This creature cannot attack back-row creatures.

name: Bonecaller
rules: Once during your pre-combat, combat, or post-combat phase, discard a card to return a Creature with printed Attack 1 or less from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Bloomstone
rules: At your turn start, heal 1 HP on each other creature in this creature’s column.

name: Azure Myconid
rules: After this creature deals combat damage to a creature, that creature gets −1 Attack until the end of its controller’s next turn.

name: Aurora Stag
rules: When you play this creature, choose an enemy creature. It gets −2 Attack until the end of its controller’s next turn.

name: Bramble Shiv
rules: When this creature attacks a damaged creature, it gets +1 Attack for that combat.

name: Cloud Sovereign
rules: While this creature is in a back slot, its front protector gets +2 maximum HP. When that protector dies, stun this creature.

name: Cindermaw
rules: When this creature attacks, deal 1 damage to the creature directly behind its target, if any. This creature cannot attack until your second turn after it is played.

name: Dewdrop Ooze
rules: When you play this creature, remove Burn from a friendly creature and heal 2 HP on that creature.

name: Crimson Fletcher
rules: While this creature has a front protector, it gets +2 Attack. Otherwise it has −1 Attack.

name: Dustdancer
rules: When you play this creature, you may swap an enemy front creature with the creature directly behind it. Both slots must be occupied.

name: Crystal Gale
rules: After this creature deals combat damage to a back-row creature, you may return that creature to its owner’s hand. Returning it is not a death.

name: Dustbound
rules: When you play this creature, remove all shield from an enemy front creature. That creature cannot gain shield until the end of your next turn.

name: Velvet Bat
rules: After this creature deals combat damage to a back-row creature, heal 1 HP on it.

name: Moonweave Cloak
rules: Equipped creature gets +1 maximum HP. The first time each turn an enemy Spell would damage it, prevent 1 of that damage.

name: Coralcrusher
rules: While this creature has half its maximum HP or less, rounded down, it takes 1 less damage from each source.

name: Hoardkeeper Coin
rules: The first time each turn you play an Equipment, look at the top card of your deck. You may put it on the bottom.

name: Glacier Cube
rules: When this creature attacks an already stunned creature, it gets +2 Attack for that combat.

name: Dawnwing
rules: When you play this creature, remove Stun or Burn from a friendly creature. If you removed an effect, heal 1 HP on that creature.

name: Hourglass of Embers
rules: At your turn start, put an ember counter here. Then you may remove 3 ember counters from here to deal 2 damage to an enemy front creature.

name: Crownless Lich
rules: After this creature deals combat damage, reduce the damaged creature’s maximum HP by 1.

name: Heart of the Grove
rules: Once per turn, after a friendly creature survives combat damage, heal 1 HP on it during post-combat. Choose only one creature.

name: Fizzlewick
rules: After this creature deals combat damage to a creature, put a fuse counter on it. At 2 fuse counters, remove those counters and deal 3 damage to that creature.

name: Prism of Echoes
rules: Play only immediately after an enemy Artifact’s turn-start ability heals a creature or deals damage. Choose one: heal 2 HP on a friendly creature; or deal 1 damage to an enemy front creature.

name: Sunforged Blade
rules: Equipped creature gets +1 Attack. When it attacks an Undead creature, it gets another +1 Attack for that combat.

name: Moonstone Bell
rules: At your turn start, you may remove Stun from one friendly creature. If you do, discard a card.

name: Thunderhead
rules: At your turn start, if this creature is in a back slot, give it a charge counter. When it attacks, you may remove a charge counter to gain +2 Attack for that combat.

name: Rootbound Idol
rules: The first time each turn an enemy creature is played in a back slot, give its front protector −1 Attack until the end of that turn.

name: Frostwalker Boots
rules: Equipped creature gets +1 maximum HP. It cannot be swapped or moved by enemy abilities.

name: Phoenix Feather
rules: Play only immediately after a friendly creature dies. Return that card to your hand. The death still counts as a loss, and it cannot be replayed this turn.

name: Tideglass Bow
rules: Equipped creature may target protected back-row creatures. It gets −1 Attack when it attacks a back-row creature.

name: Snowswirl
rules: When you play this creature in a back slot, give its front protector 2 shield. Shield from this ability does not stack with itself.

name: Sunken Compass
rules: Once during your pre-combat, combat, or post-combat phase, you may swap two friendly creatures in the same column. Swapping does not make a creature ready to attack.

name: Starlight Locket
rules: At your turn start, if you control exactly 3 creatures, you may discard a card to draw a card.

name: Rainbow Vale
rules: During each player’s post-combat phase, that player may heal 1 HP on one of their creatures that did not attack this turn.

name: Stormcaller Hammer
rules: Equipped creature gets +2 Attack and takes 1 damage after each combat in which it attacked.

name: Obsidian Mirror
rules: Play only immediately after an enemy Spell chooses a single friendly creature as its target. Change that target to another legal creature. Do not copy the Spell.

name: Brambleguard Shield
rules: Equipped creature gets +2 maximum HP. It deals 1 damage to any creature that deals combat damage to it.

name: Dragonwatch Crags
rules: Creatures in front slots get +1 Attack when attacking Dragons. Both players’ Dragons get +1 maximum HP.

name: Dragonbone Spear
rules: Equipped creature gets +1 Attack. Once each turn, after it deals combat damage to a front creature, deal 1 damage to the creature directly behind that target, if any.

name: Astral Lens
rules: Equipped creature gets +1 Attack while in a back slot. At your turn start, you may look at the top card of your deck.

name: Lantern Tortoise
rules: While this creature is in a front slot, its back-row companion cannot be chosen by enemy Spell cards.

name: Starlit Expanse
rules: At each player’s turn start, that player looks at the top card of their deck and may put it on the bottom before drawing.

name: Emberheart Armor
rules: Equipped creature gets +1 Attack and +1 maximum HP. It cannot be burned.

name: Silkstep Sandals
rules: Once during your pre-combat, combat, or post-combat phase, you may swap equipped creature with its friendly creature in the same column. Equipped creature gets +1 Attack until end of turn.

name: Wayfarer Satchel
rules: When you attach this card, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put them back in any order. Equipped creature gets +1 maximum HP.

name: Runesmith Gauntlets
rules: Equipped creature gets +1 Attack. The first time each turn it would take damage from an Artifact, prevent 1 of that damage.

name: Hearthkeeper Apron
rules: Equipped creature gets +1 maximum HP. During your post-combat phase, if it did not attack this turn, heal 1 HP on it.

name: Garden of Stars
rules: At your turn start, choose one: remove Burn from a friendly creature; or give 1 shield to a friendly creature with printed Attack 1 or less.

name: Wildflower Crown
rules: Equipped creature gets +1 maximum HP. When it is healed, it gets +1 Attack until end of turn. This can trigger once each turn.

name: Cloud Kingdom
rules: Protected back-row creatures take 1 less damage from each source. Front-row creatures cannot gain shield.

name: Ocean Pearl Ring
rules: Equipped creature gets +1 maximum HP. Once per turn, prevent the first 1 damage it would take during an enemy turn.

name: Amber Memory
rules: Play only immediately after an enemy creature declares an attack against a friendly creature. Cancel that attack. That attacker cannot declare another attack this turn.

name: Thunderseed
rules: The first time each turn you play a creature, put a spark counter here. Once during your pre-combat, combat, or post-combat phase, remove 3 spark counters to destroy an enemy Equipment.

name: Hollow Crown
rules: Play only immediately after the enemy plays an Artifact or Battlefield. Cancel that card: discard it without resolving its entry effects or replacing the current Battlefield.

name: Transposition
rules: Swap the positions of two of any of your active creatures

name: Zap
rules: Deal 2 damage to an enemy creature

name: Bounce Back
rules: Return one creature back to the enemy's hand

name: Unbury
rules: Return one creature from your discard pile to your hand

name: Quicken
rules: Grant one creature Sprint until the end of your turn

name: Foresight
rules: Look at the top 3 cards of your draw pile and place them back in any order

name: Sooth Wounds
rules: Heal 2 HP from one of your creatures

name: Mind Control
rules: Take Control of one of the other player's creatures and give it Sprint. Place it anywhere on your side of the battle map. This card will Fail if you have no empty spaces available. At the end of your turn, return it to it's original space. If that is not possible, discard it to the owner's discard pile.

name: Willful Protection
rules: Grant one of your creatures 3 shield

name: Duplicate
rules: Create a copy of a creature on the board in an empty slot on your side. The copy gains the Summon type and Sprint. Sacrifice it at the end of the turn.

name: Delve
rules: Draw two cards

name: Esoteric Implosion
rules: Destroy one Artifact or Equipment

name: Dismay
rules: Force target player to discard 1 card of their choice from their hand.

name: Pierce the Veil
rules: Target creature may ignore front line protectors and attack backline creatures until end of turn

name: Suffer the Dead
rules: Sacrifice one active creature and return 2 cards from your discard pile to your hand

name: Directed Ire
rules: Until end of your next turn, the target friendly creature must be defeated before any other of your creatures can be attacked

name: Bring it On!
rules: Target creature gains +3 Attack until end of turn

name: Spring to Life
rules: Heal all your creatures 1 HP and grant them 1 Shield

name: Choices, Choices
rules: Pick one: Deal 1 damage to creature, Heal 1 HP from creature, or draw 1 card

name: Set the Trap
rules: Mark one empty enemy creature slot. If a creature is placed on that slot, deal 10 damage to that creature. This effect lasts for 3 turns.

name: Fade to Nothing
rules: Destroy target creature. It does not count toward the creature-defeat goal.

name: Benevolent Infection
rules: All creatures gain -1 HP until end of turn

name: Disruption Pact
rules: Look at the enemy players hand and select a card. The selected card is discarded.

name: Vanguard
rules: Give all your creatures 1 Shield and Reflect while they are shielded until the end of the next turn.

name: Control the Future
rules: Draw 3 cards and then discard 1 card from your hand.

name: In Fate's Hands
rules: Flip a coin, if Heads, Destroy two target creatures, if Tails, sacrifice a creature

name: Begin Anew
rules: Both players discard their hands and draw 5 cards

name: Search the Archives
rules: Select one card from your deck and place it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: Decimate
rules: Destroy all creatures on the board. Creatures destroyed this way do not count toward the creature-defeat goal. Can only be played from turn 3 onward.

name: Spellproof Cowl
rules: Cannot be targetted by any spells

name: Mirror Plate
rules: When the equipped creature is targetted by a spell, copy the spell and choose a new target

name: Liquid Magic
rules: Whenever you play a Spell card, choose a creature, that creature gains +1 Attack this turn

name: Arcane Amplifier
rules: Spells you cast that deal damage will deal +1 extra damage

name: Portal to the Shattered Realms
rules: Whenever any player draws a card, gain one stack of Displacement. At 5 stacks you must move one creature to another free slot on the board. The chosen slot must be on the same side of the board that the creature originated from. If no slots are available, nothing happens. All stacks are expended regardless of if the movement was successful or not.

name: Countermagic
rules: When an enemy spell is played, cancel the effect of the Spell card and discard it.

name: Realmskipper
rules: Whenever you play a spell, this creature gains +1 Attack until end of turn

name: Cerulean Sprite
rules: When this card is played, Draw 1 card

name: Animated Tome
rules: When this card is played, return one Spell card from your discard pile to your hand

name: Feverish Academic
rules: When this creature attacks you may discard a spell card and Feverish Academic gains +2 Attack

name: Dirge Scuttler
rules: When this creature deals damage to a creature, destroy that creature

name: Gifted Aspirant
rules: When this creature receives combat damage, draw 1 card

name: Seer of the Realms
rules: Whenever you draw a card, deal 1 damage to a target creature

name: Professor Riddledum
rules: Other Mages you control gain +1 Attack. Whenever a Mage you control dies, draw 1 card.

name: Soultorn Recluse
rules: Whenever another friendly Mage is played, gain +1 Attack and +1 Shield.

name: Rhodovan
rules: All enemy creatures in the lane opposite of Rhodovan deal -1 Attack damage. When Rhodovan is defeated return the card to your hand.

name: The Orator of the Void
rules: When played, search your library for a Spell card and put it into your hand. Whenever you play a spell card, you may heal all mages 1 HP.

name: Pebble Slinger
rules: When played gained 3 stacks of "Pebbles". Each turn on either the pre-combat or post-combat phase, you may consume one stack and deal 1 damage to target creature.

name: Fireback Basilisk
rules: When this creature defeats a front-line enemy, stun the enemy behind them if there is one.

name: Flamebrew Witch
rules: When played, grant one friendly creature Sprint and +1 Attack until end of turn.

name: Goblin Punk
rules: Gain +1 Attack whenever another Goblin creature is played until end of turn

name: Warg Runt
rules: Gain +2 Attack when at full HP and -1 Attack when less than full HP.

name: Flamespark Elemental
rules: Sacrifice at the end of your turn

name: Riggel, Gold Glutton
rules: Whenever this creature takes combat damage, generate a "Gold" stack. When this creature is defeated by combat damage, heal another friendly creature X HP where X is the number of Gold stacks accumlated.

name: Rebel Rouser
rules: When played, return one Wiskin creature from your discard to your hand

name: Greyfur Physician
rules: At the end of your combat phase, heal 1 HP from one of your creatures

name: Burrowborn Magikitten
rules: After each of your Draw Phases, you may choose to discard as many cards as you wish. Deal X damage to target creature, where X is the number of cards discarded this way

name: Wiskin Bannerling
rules: When played, give all creatures in your front rank 1 Shield

name: Prodfoot Steer
rules: This creature attacks every turn, if able. This creature gains +1 Attack during the enemy's turn.

name: Makeshift Battering Ram
rules: If this creature's combat damage is reduced to 0, stun this creature.

name: Gobskin Sympathizer
rules: Gain +1 Attack if you control another Goblin. Gain +1 Shield if you control another Wiskin.

name: Messenger Hawk
rules: When played, return one of your creatures to your hand

name: Goblin Channeler
rules: At each of your pre-combat phases, grant Goblin Channeler one stack of "Channel". If there is a creature in front of Goblin Channeler, grant that creature +X Attack where X is the number of "Channel" stacks.

name: Edelberry Burrow
rules: Wiskin gain Restore 1

name: The Vicious Maw
rules: Goblins gain Sprint

name: Goblin Totem
rules: Whenever a Goblin dies, draw a card

name: Wiskin Cutlass
rules: +1 Attack. Also, if this is equipped to a Wiskin, whenever the equipped creature defeats an enemy draw 1 card

name: Urkjaw Bloodfist
rules: All Goblins gain +1 Attack

name: Royal Knight Eklo
rules: Whenever this creature attacks, all other Wiskin gain +1 Attack until end of turn

name: Fireback Rider
rules: When Fireback Rider dies, summon a Fireback Basilisk in it's place.

name: Cloudcarriage Captain
rules: Cloudcarriage Captain may only be played in the back rank. When played, summon 1 Soldier of Edelberry to the space in front of it, if available, then grant the creature in front of it shield 3

name: Obelisk of Fis'Duum
rules: Creatures the enemy plays enter stunned

name: Shackles of Nim
rules: Equipped creature splits damage between itself and any other friendly creature equipped with Shackles of Nim. For odd numbered damage, the targetted friendly creature will take the higher of the two split values.

name: Champion's Tunic
rules: Equipped creature gains Resilient and +1 Attack

name: Brooch of the Ancients
rules: Equipped creature's Attack is equal to the highest attack among other active friendly creatures

name: Torn Banner
rules: Equipped creature gains Stalwart 2. If the Equipped creature dies, Torn Banner becomes an Artifact and you must choose one of your artifact slots to assign it. It's effect becomes "Friendly creatures gain Stalwart 2"

name: Ring of Disassociation
rules: Equipped creature ignores the effect of the active Battlefield card.

name: Dissect
rules: Remove all Ward and Shield from a creature

name: Share the Pain
rules: Deal 1 damage to a friendly creature and 1 damage to each of the enemy creatures in the same lane opposite to the targetted friendly creature

name: Blood for Blood
rules: Deal 2 damage to target friendly creature, Draw 3 cards

name: Cure All
rules: Remove all negative statuses from a target friendly creature

name: Unearth Antiquities
rules: Put one Artifact card from either discard pile into your hand. That card cannot be played until the next turn

name: Invisibility
rules: Grant 1 creature "Invisible" until next turn

name: Back in Action
rules: Draw 1 card, if that card is a creature card, play it immediately and it gains Sprint until end of turn

name: Unsummon
rules: If the enemy player plays a creature of type "Summon", destroy that creature

name: Demotivate
rules: Target creature's attack becomes 0 until end of turn

name: Level the Field
rules: The player with the most amount of active creatures sacrifices creatures until they have the same number of active creatures as the player with the least amount of active creatures

name: Raise the Dead
rules: Return all friendly creatures that were put into the discard pile this turn back onto the battlefield. You may choose new placements for these creatures. These creatures are not Summons.

name: Loriadre, Angel of War
rules: You may only have a single Loriadre in your deck. Whenever a friendly creature dies, deal 1 damage to target creature. Whenever an enemy creature dies, heal a friendly creature 1 HP. Mythic: Removed from the game instead of entering a discard pile.

name: Enrapture
rules: All allied creatures gain +2 Attack and Shield 2 until end of turn. Apply Stun to all affected creatures at the start of your next turn.

name: Seraphim Scepter
rules: When equipped creature attacks return a creature from your discard pile and put it into play in an empty slot, if there is one. That creature gains Sprint and is sacrificed at the end of the turn. Mythic: Removed from the game instead of entering a discard pile.

name: Spelltwine Altar
rules: Whenever the enemy draws their second card of the turn, you draw a card as well.

name: Momentary Allegiance
rules: If the enemy puts a creature into play, you may play this card and gain control of the creature until the end of your next turn. That creature gains Sprint.

name: Earth
art_direction: Sunlit ochre canyon with towering striated sandstone pillars, jade river ribbon far below, tiny distant caravan for scale. Sweeping low viewpoint, burnt sienna, cobalt and golden noon.

name: Sky
art_direction: Immense open pale-blue sky above a thin sea of white clouds, towering sculptural cumulus lit pink from sunrise, lone tiny floating feather close foreground. Minimal expansive composition, airy cyan, pearl and rose.

name: Fire
art_direction: Intimate ground-level view inside a volcanic lava cavern, molten orange river flowing around obsidian spires, black ceiling, smoke and flying sparks. Bold near-black versus white-hot orange, no green or purple.

name: Water
art_direction: Crystal-clear turquoise tropical lagoon seen half underwater: sun shafts, colourful coral foreground and distant limestone sea arches above waterline. Luminous aqua, coral red and deep marine blue.

name: Dark
art_direction: Enormous abandoned gothic castle silhouetted on a jagged ridge beneath a starless eclipse, winding pale fog swallowing foreground. Extremely restrained charcoal, indigo and bone-white, dramatic negative space, no glowing purple crystals.

name: Light
art_direction: Radiant white-gold sun breaking over rolling fields of ivory flowers, prismatic motes and soft golden trees, close dewy petals foreground, horizon flooded with warm light. Cream, amber and pale mint, joyful exposure.

name: Floating Ruins
art_direction: Aerial oblique view of broken ancient stone temples on floating moss-covered islands above a vast cloud abyss, cascading waterfalls vanish below, small hanging bridges. Weathered stone, emerald and azure, dizzying vertical scale.

name: Ashlands
art_direction: Wide desolate black ash dunes crossing a red mesa desert, smoking fissures in foreground, a ruined watchtower nearly buried in ash, wind whips cinders under a copper storm sky. Rust, black and muted bronze, harsh diagonal composition.

name: Sunken City
art_direction: Deep underwater boulevard of a submerged marble city, sea grass grows over statues and algae-covered stairs, gigantic domes recede into teal gloom, schools of silver fish and a distant whale. Tranquil blue-green and limestone white, street-level perspective.

name: Crypt of Vailyn
art_direction: Claustrophobic underground sepulchre of rough earth and roots, elaborately carved basalt sarcophagus at lower right, single cold green witch-flame illuminating engraved stone, bone dust in narrow light shaft. Moss-black and sickly pale green, close scale, no skull piles.

name: Vibrant Meadow
art_direction: Macro-low perspective through red poppies and yellow wildflowers toward a lush sweeping meadow, warm afternoon sun, a tiny rustic windmill on distant hill, bees and butterflies. Saturated scarlet, fresh lime, cornflower blue, exuberant natural abundance.

name: Miredin's Pass
art_direction: Treacherous narrow mountain pass suspended between immense storm clouds, brilliant comet-like streams of fire crossing overhead, rope bridge curling around dark peaks, view from a precarious ledge. Steel blue storm versus blazing vermilion, fierce wind.

name: Inverted Sea
art_direction: Surreal ocean suspended upside-down overhead, enormous translucent waves and a whale hanging in the sky above a dry white salt plain, vertical rain ribbons connecting earth and ocean. Wide ground-level upward view, icy blue, silver and soft peach horizon.

name: Twilight Strand
art_direction: Lonely black-sand shoreline seeming to float among twilight clouds, crescent moon, a skeletal driftwood arch and distant dark birds, reflected starlight on narrow tide pools. Quiet lavender-grey, midnight and a single crimson sunset band, sparse asymmetrical framing.

name: Loriadre's Reliquary
art_direction: Open-air celestial reliquary on a gleaming white stone platform above clouds, delicate golden architectural ribs surrounding one suspended luminous glass vessel, silk banners glowing in morning light. Close architectural study, alabaster, pale gold, gentle sky blue, no character portrait.

name: Boiling Delta
art_direction: High overhead view of branching milky turquoise geothermal rivers meeting glowing volcanic channels, immense steam plumes and vivid orange mineral banks, intricate branching natural pattern. Turquoise, sulphur yellow and orange, cartographic scale without labels.

name: Tezzakeen's Hall
art_direction: Cavernous demonic banquet hall carved from black volcanic glass, empty elongated table leads to a monumental furnace throne, embers drip like chandeliers, reflected red fire in polished floor. Symmetrical one-point perspective, deep burgundy, black and ember gold.

name: Candlelight Sept
art_direction: Humble intimate seven-sided stone chapel at night, hundreds of warm candles on stepped wooden ledges and a small stained-glass sun window, comforting amber light catching floating dust. Human-scale interior, honey gold, rich brown and subtle cobalt window accents.

name: Abyssal Depths
art_direction: Vertiginous descent into a pitch-black ocean trench, huge ancient stone face barely visible on canyon wall, sparse tiny blue bioluminescent creatures reveal unimaginable depth. Near-black and electric cyan, powerful negative space and atmospheric obscurity.

name: Celestial Estuary
art_direction: Gently curving river estuary at dawn where luminous gold freshwater meets a pearlescent sea, white wading birds reflected in shallow pools, tiny star-like motes among reeds. Serene low panoramic view, champagne gold, blush pink and pale seafoam.

name: Moonrend Delve
art_direction: Subterranean crystal cleft split by a razor-thin shaft of brilliant moonlight, one side pure white sparkling mineral and the other dark untouched stone, still black reflecting pool. Severe black-white contrast with restrained cold silver, dramatic tilted upward viewpoint.

name: Sacred Spring
rules: Heal the creature occupying this hex by 1 HP at the start of its controller’s pre-combat phase.
art_direction: A tiny sacred spring wells from between ancient tree roots into a round mossy stone basin, golden sunlight rests on the water, medicinal blue flowers and fresh fern fronds frame the intimate sanctuary. Warm olive, turquoise and soft gold, close low eye-level view.

name: Wall of Light
rules: At the beginning of your opponent’s combat phase, grant 1 Shield to the creature you control directly behind this hex.
art_direction: An immense translucent golden wall shaped from interlocking luminous hexagons shields a quiet grassy courtyard from a distant storm of dark arrows, camera skims along its edge so protective depth is clear. Brilliant honey-white versus slate blue, sharp geometric shapes, no people prominent.

name: Erupt
rules: Change one of the enemy’s hexes into a Volcanic Vent.
art_direction: Violent instant a peaceful grassy field ruptures upward in a cone of magma and shattered rock, roots and soil torn into the air, a tiny distant fleeing goblin establishes scale. Dynamic extreme low ground-level angle, fierce red-orange explosion against saturated cyan sky, kinetic magical spell scene.

name: Volcanic Vent
rules: Deal 1 damage to the creature occupying this hex at the start of its controller’s pre-combat phase.
art_direction: Close downward view of a circular jagged volcanic vent embedded in cracked basalt, white-hot gas jets escape through a glowing central fissure, red mineral crust and scorched dry weeds. Intense white centre, dark umber and sulphur orange, contained hazardous place, not a volcano panorama.

name: Door to Ashgar
rules: At the beginning of each of your combat phases, if this hex is empty, summon one Goblin Punk. That creature gains Sprint and Doomed.
art_direction: Tall weather-beaten wooden door stands alone on a windswept grassy ridge, its open doorway reveals a blazing goblin war camp in another realm; one scrappy green goblin punk with red crest is stepping through, other small goblin silhouettes behind. Cool emerald dusk outside, orange fire within, strong doorway silhouette and magical threshold.
